name: Peligros (Spain)
description: Burgundy field with five light blue waves along the hoist and a large golden newt at the fly.
history: Peligros has its own arms and flag, although they have not been made official under the regional regulations, which does not prevent their widespread use; the ensign used by the municipality since January 2026 is a rectangular burgundy flag with five soft blue waves at the hoist and a large golden newt at the fly.

features.role: five soft waves along the hoist side
